Priya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — new Engineering Lead (Jordan K) starts Mon. I made a compact "starter rituals" checklist + light day-by-day agenda. Please skim and add any who-to-ask contacts or must-do setup items.
Daniel (Eng): Thanks! Can we confirm laptop provisioning + AD group? last time it took 3 days.
Sara (People Ops): I'll ping infra and set up laptop ticket. @OnboardBot can you attach the hardware SLA?
OnboardBot: Hardware request created: #HW-4521. ETA 48h for config. Link: https://tickets.example/HW-4521
Maya (HR): Payroll + benefits forms sent yesterday. Remind Jordan to e-sign I-9 and direct deposit. Also: add 1:1 with People Ops on Day 2.
Priya (People Ops): Day-by-day sketch:
```
Day 0 (pre-boarding): invite + systems access, Slack, email, laptop ticket
Day 1: team intro, buddy lunch, security quickstart
Day 2: org overview, 1:1 w/People Ops, benefits walkthrough
Day 3: product walkthrough, first micro-ticket
Day 4: infra runbook + deploy demo
Day 5: 30/60/90 sync + ask-anything
```
Alex (Eng Manager): For 30/60/90 — keep it outcome-focused: Week1 ramp (read docs, setup), 30d deliverable = onboard a small bugfix, 60d = lead mini-feature, 90d = own a roadmap slice.
Daniel (Eng): + add access to dedicated GPU cluster for experiment runs — email infra@redwood.com and cc Jordan.
Priya (People Ops): New items added: GPU access, security training slot, Slack channel invites. Sara — assigning buddy (Lina) to day1 lunch.
Sara (People Ops): Assigned. Also created short pulse survey for EoW day5 to catch blockers.
Maya (HR): Note: KMS key access requires signed NDA before private repo access. Flagged in checklist.
Alex (Eng Manager): I'll schedule the 1:1 cadence and set the first 30/60/90 check-in on calendar.
Priya (People Ops): Awesome — if anyone has tiny must-do items (license keys, vendor forms), drop them here. :party_parrot:
Daniel (Eng): Sending list of vendor/form keys in a follow-up DM.
Priya (People Ops): thanks team — will finalize and post the one-pager in #new-hires by EOD.
